onboarding.consentIntro: Please review how we handle your health information.

terms.title: Terms of use
terms.body: Health Companion gives health information and organizes your records. It is not a doctor, pharmacist or emergency service.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.body: Your data is private to your account, encrypted in transit and at rest, and stored by Supabase in Frankfurt, Germany. You can export or delete it at any time.

health_data_processing.title: Storing your health information
health_data_processing.body: We store the health records, documents and medications you add so the app can track them over time.

ai_processing.title: AI reading and explanations
ai_processing.body: Lets the app send your documents and relevant records to Anthropic (Claude) to read reports and answer your questions. Anthropic does not use this data to train models. Without it, you can still enter results manually.

onboarding.adultConfirm: I confirm I am 18 or older
onboarding.legalDraftNote: Beta: the full terms and privacy policy are being finalized and you will be asked to review them before public launch.
onboarding.profileIntro: All optional — it helps us tailor ranges and suggestions.
onboarding.name: What should we call you?
onboarding.dobWhy: Some results are interpreted differently by age.
onboarding.mustBeAdult: You must be 18 or older to use the app.
onboarding.withoutAi: Without AI reading, scanning reports and prescriptions won't work. You can turn it on later in Settings.
onboarding.requiredConsents: Terms, privacy and health data storage are needed to use the app.
onboarding.mustConfirmAdult: You must be 18 or older to use the app.
onboarding.pregnancyIntro: Some lab ranges and medicine notes differ during pregnancy or breastfeeding. Optional.
onboarding.familyIntro: Conditions in parents, brothers or sisters. This changes which checkups we suggest. Optional.
onboarding.goalsIntro: What would you like help with? Optional.
onboarding.doctorIntro: Your main doctor's name, to prepare summaries for visits. Optional.
onboarding.alertsIntro: Turn on notifications so we can remind you to take your medicines.

onboarding.startScanReportHint: Photo or PDF of your test results
onboarding.startAddMedicineHint: Set reminders for a medicine you take
onboarding.startScanPrescriptionHint: We'll read the medicines for you

lock.title: Private to you
lock.body: Only you can see your records. We never sell them or use them for ads.

place.title: Stored in Germany
place.body: Encrypted in transit and at rest, in Frankfurt (EU).

ai.title: AI reading is essential
ai.body: It's how the app reads your reports and prescriptions. Anthropic (Claude) doesn't use your data for training.

scan.title: Scan a report
scan.subtitle: Take a photo of a lab report or upload a PDF. You'll check everything before it's saved.
scan.limits: JPEG, PNG, WebP or PDF · up to 20 MB and 20 pages
scan.readingHint: This usually takes under a minute. You can leave this screen; the report will wait for you in Records.
scan.savedOther: Your document is saved. Reviewing prescriptions and doctor reports comes in a later update.
scan.duplicate: You've already uploaded this exact file.
scan.enterManuallyHint: Type values from a paper report. No AI is used.
scan.uploadError: The upload didn't complete. Check your connection and try again.

invalid.type: This file type isn't supported. Use a JPEG, PNG, WebP image or a PDF.
invalid.size: This file is larger than 20 MB.

start.consent_required: AI reading isn't allowed for your account. Allow it above, or enter results manually.
start.quota_exceeded: You've reached this month's limit of 30 scanned documents. You can still enter results manually.
start.ai_not_configured: Report reading isn't set up yet. Your file is saved; try again later or enter results manually.
start.error: We couldn't start reading this report. Your file is saved; try again.

failure.ai_unavailable: The reading service is unavailable right now. Your file is saved; try again.
failure.timeout: Reading is taking longer than expected. Check Records in a few minutes.
failure.ai_refused: This document couldn't be read automatically. Enter the results manually.
failure.document_too_long: This document is too long to read in one go. Try uploading fewer pages.
failure.invalid_ai_output: The reading result was incomplete. Try again.
failure.save_failed: We read the report but couldn't save the draft. Try again.
failure.file_missing: The uploaded file couldn't be found. Upload it again.
failure.too_many_pages: This PDF has more than 20 pages. Upload only the pages with results.
failure.unreadable: We couldn't read this document. Try a clearer, well-lit photo.
failure.ai_busy: The reading service is busy. Try again in a minute.
failure.ai_not_configured: Report reading isn't set up yet. Try again later.
failure.ai_rejected_file: This file couldn't be processed. Try a different photo or PDF.
failure.image_too_large: This photo is too large to read. Try a photo with a lower resolution, or a PDF.

review.title: Check your results
review.subtitle: Results that were read clearly are listed at the bottom. Only the ones below need your check.
review.duplicate: A confirmed report from the same date has almost identical results. If this is the same report, discard this copy.
review.dateFallback: Only a report date was found, so it is used as the collection date. I've checked this date.
review.dateUncertain: The day and month order on this report may be ambiguous. I've checked this date.
review.unitNotComparable: This unit can't be converted to {{unit}}, so this result won't be compared with your other results for this test.
review.unmatchedHint: Not in the app's list. It will still be tracked by its printed name and unit. Pick the test if you know it; the app will remember it next time.
review.checkedAgainstDoc: I've checked the highlighted fields against the document

problems.name: Every result needs a test name.
problems.unchecked: Check the highlighted fields and tick the box under each one.

review.saveError: Saving didn't work. Nothing was changed; try again.
review.discardConfirm: Discard this report? Its draft results won't be saved.
review.notFound: This report isn't available for review.
review.aiMatchUnit: Looks like {{test}}, but the unit doesn't fit that test. Pick the test if you're sure.

report.sourceNote: Values come from your confirmed report. Status labels compare each value with the range printed by the lab; they are not a diagnosis.
report.notComparable: Not compared: the unit or date can't be matched with your other results.
report.byNameOnly: Compared by printed name and unit only: this test isn't in the app's list yet.
report.unrecognized: Not in the app's list yet. Future results with the same name and unit will be compared with this one.
report.removeConfirm: Remove this result from your record? The original is kept in the change history.
report.correctionNote: The original value is kept in the change history. All comparisons will use the corrected value.

liver.borderline: Borderline elevation ({{fold}}× the lab's upper limit). On its own this doesn't establish liver injury; worth discussing with your doctor at your next visit.
liver.mild: Mild elevation ({{fold}}× the lab's upper limit). Discuss with your doctor, who may suggest repeating the test.
liver.moderate: Moderate elevation ({{fold}}× the lab's upper limit). Contact your doctor soon to review this result.
liver.severe: Marked elevation ({{fold}}× the lab's upper limit). Contact your doctor promptly today.
liver.massive: Very high result. Seek medical care today.

history.notFound: No results found for this test.
history.noNumeric: This test has no numeric results to chart.
history.notCompared: Not included (different unit that can't be converted)
history.changesNote: Shown for context. A change around the same time doesn't mean it caused a change in your results.

chart.summary: Chart of {{count}} results from {{first}} to {{last}}. Latest: {{value}}.
chart.bandNote: Shaded band: the normal range printed on your latest report. Tap a point for details; tap again to open its report.

compare.title: Compare reports
compare.subtitle: Two report dates side by side. Changes are calculated by the app, not by AI.
compare.needTwo: Confirm at least two lab reports to compare them.

insights.title: Insights
insights.subtitle: What stands out in your confirmed results, with the values and dates behind each point.
insights.empty: Nothing stands out in your confirmed results right now.
insights.disclaimer: Insights are calculated by the app from your confirmed results and published guidelines. They are health information, not a diagnosis. Dismissing an insight never changes your results.

level.urgent: Urgent medical attention may be needed

critical_value.title: {{test}} needs prompt medical attention
critical_value.body: Your {{test}} of {{value}} {{unit}} on {{date}} is beyond a limit that laboratories treat as critical.
critical_value.action: Contact your doctor today. If you feel unwell, call {{emergency}} or go to the nearest emergency department.

outside_range_high.title: {{test}} is above the lab's range
outside_range_high.body: {{value}} {{unit}} on {{date}} (lab range {{range}}). A single result outside the range is common and is not a diagnosis on its own.
outside_range_high.action: Mention it at your next doctor visit.

outside_range_low.title: {{test}} is below the lab's range
outside_range_low.body: {{value}} {{unit}} on {{date}} (lab range {{range}}). A single result outside the range is common and is not a diagnosis on its own.
outside_range_low.action: Mention it at your next doctor visit.

ldl_severe_190.title: LDL cholesterol is 190 mg/dL or higher
ldl_severe_190.body: Your LDL of {{value}} {{unit}} on {{date}} is in the range that cholesterol guidelines treat as severely high.

hba1c_diabetes_range.title: HbA1c is in the diabetes range
hba1c_diabetes_range.body: {{value}}{{unit}} on {{date}} is 6.5% or higher, the range used to diagnose diabetes. One result is not a diagnosis: guidelines require a confirming test.

hba1c_prediabetes_range.title: HbA1c is in the prediabetes range
hba1c_prediabetes_range.body: {{value}}{{unit}} on {{date}} is between 5.7% and 6.4%, the range guidelines call prediabetes.
hba1c_prediabetes_range.action: Worth discussing at your next doctor visit.

egfr_category.title: Kidney filtration (eGFR) is in category {{category}}
egfr_category.body: {{value}} {{unit}} on {{date}}. Category {{category}} means kidney filtration is lower than normal.
egfr_category.action: Discuss it with your doctor, who may repeat the test.

trend_improving.title: {{test}} has improved
trend_improving.body: From {{previousValue}} on {{previousDate}} to {{value}} {{unit}} on {{date}} ({{percent}}). The change is larger than normal day-to-day variation.

trend_worsening.title: {{test}} has moved further from the lab's range
trend_worsening.body: From {{previousValue}} on {{previousDate}} to {{value}} {{unit}} on {{date}} ({{percent}}). The change is larger than normal day-to-day variation.
trend_worsening.action: Worth discussing at your next doctor visit.

info.title: What this means
info.high: What a high result can mean
info.low: What a low result can mean
info.within: Your result is within the range printed by your lab.
info.medicines: If your doctor has prescribed medicine for this, keep taking it exactly as prescribed. Don't stop or change it without talking to your doctor first.
info.learnMore: Learn more at MedlinePlus (US National Library of Medicine)
info.disclaimer: General health information, not personal medical advice. Your doctor will interpret your result with your full history.

meds.addSubtitle: Enter it as written on your prescription or the package.
meds.changeSubtitle: Record a new dose or timing your doctor gave you. The previous one is kept in the history.
meds.checkHighlighted: Check the highlighted fields against your prescription. Anything not written on it is left for you to fill in.
meds.name: Medicine name
meds.timesHint: Times are in your time zone ({{tz}}).
meds.endDate: Ends on (if prescribed for a fixed time)
meds.supplyHint: You'll get a reminder 3 days before to renew it.
meds.confirmChecked: I have checked the medicine name, strength, dose and times against my prescription or package.
meds.neverInfer: The app never guesses a dose or schedule. Take your medicine as your doctor prescribed.
meds.pharmacistReview: You're taking more than one medicine. The app doesn't check for interactions; ask your pharmacist or doctor to review your full list, including supplements.
meds.disclaimer: This list is a record you keep, not a prescription. Don't start, stop or change a medicine without your doctor.
meds.stopExplain: Record the day you stopped, for example because your doctor told you to. It stays in your history.
meds.selfReported: Doses are what you record; "not recorded" doesn't mean missed.

suggest.note: Suggestions are names only. Check the name and strength against your prescription.

photo.hint: Your photo helps you recognize this medicine.
photo.addHint: Add a photo of the box or pills so you can recognize this medicine easily.

uses.title: Commonly used for
uses.unknown: We don't have information about this medicine yet. Ask your doctor or pharmacist what it's for.
uses.note: General information only. Your doctor may prescribe it for a different reason; follow their instructions.
uses.learnMore: Learn more at MedlinePlus (US National Library of Medicine)
uses.aiLabel: AI summary, not reviewed by a pharmacist. Check with your doctor or pharmacist.
uses.likelyContains: Likely contains {{ingredient}}. Check the package to confirm.

meds.prescriberHint: Start typing or pick a doctor you entered before
meds.editSubtitle: Fix the name, strength, doctor or instructions.
meds.editNote: To change the dose or times, use "Change dose or time" on the medicine's page; that keeps the history of earlier doses. Every edit is kept in the change history.
meds.correctHint: Fixing a mistake rather than recording a new dose? Set the date below to {{date}} (when the current dose started); the current dose is then corrected instead of replaced.

docReview.title: Review your prescription
docReview.subtitle: Add each medicine after checking it. Nothing is added to your list until you confirm it.
docReview.noMedicines: No medicines were found in this document.
docReview.unclear: Some of this was hard to read; you'll be asked to check it.
docReview.addMedicine: Check and add to my medications
docReview.followUpNote: These are your doctor's written instructions. Choose the date yourself if none was written.
docReview.deleteConfirm: Delete this scanned document? It can't be undone. Medicines you already added from it stay in your list.
docReview.deleteNote: Deleting removes the scan and what was read from it. Medicines and reminders you already confirmed stay.

reminders.title: Reminders
reminders.subtitle: Lab tests, appointments, follow-ups and renewals.
reminders.empty: No reminders yet. Add one, or create them from a doctor's follow-up instructions.
reminders.deliveryNote: Reminders appear here and on Home. Phone, email or WhatsApp notifications depend on your settings and device; a reminder is never marked as delivered unless that is confirmed.

settings.title: Settings
settings.notificationsIntro: How you'd like to be reminded about medicines and follow-ups. Reminders always appear in the app too.

pushState.unsupported: This browser can't show notifications. Try Chrome, Edge, Firefox or Safari.
pushState.needs_install: On iPhone and iPad, first add the app to your Home Screen (Share → Add to Home Screen), then open it from there.
pushState.not_configured: Notifications aren't set up on the server yet.
pushState.denied: Notifications are blocked in your browser settings for this site.

settings.emailHint: For lab tests, appointments and follow-ups when a phone notification can't be sent.
settings.whatsappHint: Used when a phone notification can't be sent. Enter your number with country code.
settings.saveError: Couldn't save. Check the WhatsApp number (e.g. +201001234567).
settings.privacyOfMessages: Messages never include medicine names or results, only "open the app to see your reminder".

suggestions.title: Suggested checkups
suggestions.intro: Based on your results and medicines, following published medical guidelines. Pick a date and add a reminder, or dismiss.

rules.statin_first_check: Cholesterol test after starting or changing your cholesterol medicine
rules.tsh_dose_check: TSH test after your thyroid dose changed

intervals.weeks4to12: guidelines suggest 4–12 weeks after a change
intervals.months3: guidelines suggest about every 3 months while treatment is changing or above goal
intervals.months6: guidelines suggest at least twice a year when stable
intervals.yearly: guidelines suggest at least once a year
intervals.weeks6to8: guidelines suggest 6–8 weeks after a dose change
intervals.months6to12: guidelines suggest every 6–12 months when stable

suggestions.disclaimer: Suggested by the app from published guidelines, not your doctor's order. If your doctor gave you a different schedule, follow theirs.

lifestyle.title: Life changes
lifestyle.subtitle: Record changes in your daily life. They help explain changes in your results.
lifestyle.homeLink: Log a life change (exercise, diet, smoking…)
lifestyle.whatHint: e.g. Started walking 30 minutes a day
lifestyle.empty: No life changes yet. Started exercising, changed your diet or quit smoking? Add it here.
lifestyle.why: Life changes appear on your timeline and next to your test results, and the advisor takes them into account. They're private to your account.

profileFields.sexWhy: Normal ranges for some tests differ by sex.
profileFields.countryWhy: Used for local units and guidelines.

family.early_heart: Heart attack or stroke at a young age

profile.title: My profile
profile.subtitle: Everything here is optional. You can change it any time.
profile.settingsHint: Age, conditions, allergies, family history, goals
profile.fromDocuments: Conditions and allergies found in your documents also appear here. Removing one here removes only what you added yourself.
profile.completeBody: A few answers make your ranges and suggestions more accurate.

trust.reviewPending: These rules follow published guidelines. A clinician review is in progress.

privacy.title: Privacy Center
privacy.subtitle: What happens to your records, and your controls over them.
privacy.settingsHint: AI use, consent history, activity, download, delete account

who.title: Only you can see your records
who.body: Nobody else has access, including other users. We never sell your data or use it for ads.

where.title: Stored in Frankfurt, Germany
where.body: On Supabase servers in the EU.

encrypted.title: Encrypted
encrypted.body: Encrypted in transit (HTTPS) and at rest.

notifications.title: Discreet reminders
notifications.body: Reminders never show medicine names or results on your lock screen.

ai.title: AI reading
ai.body: Sends documents and the records relevant to your question to Anthropic (Claude). Anthropic does not use them to train models.

uses.documents: Reading lab reports and prescriptions you scan
uses.advisor: Answering your questions in the advisor
uses.medicines: Looking up what an unknown medicine is used for (only the medicine name is sent)

export.title: Download my data
export.body: A ZIP file with all your records (data.json) and the original documents and photos you uploaded.
export.error: The download couldn't be prepared. Please try again.

activity.title: Recent activity
activity.body: Changes to your records, newest first. Only you can see this.

signOutAll.title: Sign out everywhere
signOutAll.body: Signs you out on every phone and computer, including this one.

delete.title: Delete my account
delete.body: Permanently deletes your account, all your health records, documents, photos, medicines and reminders. This cannot be undone.
delete.exportFirst: You may want to download your data first.
delete.error: Your account couldn't be deleted. Nothing more was removed; please try again.
